# Guangdong Indigo Cotton Textile Co., Ltd.
> Denim Fabric & Cotton Fabric Manufacturer & Stock Supplier  
> https://www.indigocn.com/

## About
Guangdong Indigo Cotton Textile Co., Ltd. ("靛棉纺织") is a professional denim fabric and cotton fabric manufacturer based in Foshan, Guangdong, China. Founded in 2016, we operate a 5,000 sqm factory with annual output exceeding 10 million meters. We serve 200+ brands globally across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

## Key Differentiators
- **Minimum Order**: 1 meter per style — ideal for sampling and small brands
- **Speed**: 3-5 day sampling, 1-week bulk production
- **Certification**: OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100
- **Stock**: 300+ patterns available for immediate shipment
- **Yarn range**: 10s to 32s

## Product Categories

### Denim Fabrics
1. **Non-Stretch Denim**: 103 series (370-380g, 170-180cm), 6018 (234g, 170cm), 6038 (270g, 170cm)
   - Compositions: cotton/polyester/viscose blends
   - Applications: jeans, jackets, skirts, workwear
2. **Stretch Denim**: 106-3 (283g, 170cm), 1123-1/DM31 (357g, 160cm), 108-1 (280g, 170cm)
   - Cotton/polyester/spandex blends
   - Stretch recovery tested, US/UK market ready
3. **Knitted Denim**: DM51 (240g, 150cm) — lightweight, breathable
4. **Jacquard Denim**: 2211 (360g, 180cm) — textured, premium
5. **Printed/Discharge/Overdye**: Custom, value-added finishes

### Cotton Fabrics
1. **Solid Cotton**: 560 (240g, 149cm, 16S), 681 (283g, 150cm, 10S), 5637 (125g, 150cm, 40S), 5648 (100g, 152cm, 40S)
2. **Stretch Cotton**: 007 (290g, 150cm, 98%C/2%SP), 682 (310g, 155cm, 98%C/2%SP)
3. **Custom Development**: Sample in 3-5 days

## Technical Capabilities
- **Weaving**: Rapier and air-jet looms, 4-15oz range
- **Dyeing**: Indigo, sulfur, overdye
- **Finishing**: Sanforizing, enzyme, stone wash, snow wash, sandblast, whiskering, silicone, laser, coating, embroidery
- **Quality**: OEKO-TEX® certified, AQL 2.5 inspection, third-party inspection supported

## Business Information
- **MOQ**: 1 meter
- **Sample**: 3-5 days (nominal cost, deductible from bulk order)
- **Bulk**: Within 1 week for stock items
- **Shipping**: FOB Shenzhen/Guangzhou, CIF worldwide, express available
- **Payment**: T/T, L/C at sight
